# Engineering workflow

Use the installed Temari skill for every software engineering request in this repository. Temari and its packaged P-stack instructions choose the engineering playbook from the request. This file does not select a route.

Keep Temari's repository-native workflow record for the selected playbook. The final response is blocked until the workflow tool writes a passing revision-bound receipt. Write all working and procedural evidence outside the repository, then ingest only the required hashed copies into ignored `.temari/runs/`. Keep procedural evidence separate from product checks, and do not add evidence directories or files to the product diff.
